$comment: Audit manifest for scripts/optimizer-ci.mjs (see README 'Running the optimizer in CI'). Each entry names one SELF-CONTAINED function the sandbox can run: no imports, no closures over file-level helpers, none of the sandbox's forbidden identifiers (async/Promise/fetch/constructor/...). `baseline` is a CEILING, not an expectation — set it one bucket above the true complexity so timing noise at the fixed probe sizes (100/1000/10000) cannot fail a build; the check exists to catch real regressions like O(n) -> O(n^2), which clear a one-bucket margin easily. `file` is repo-root-relative.

entries.name: bigo-mean
entries.note: True complexity O(n) (single reduce). Ceiling includes one bucket of headroom: at these probe sizes the run times sit near the measurement noise floor.

entries.name: llm-formatMs
entries.note: True complexity O(1). Ceiling includes one bucket of headroom for noise.
